notes: SoftBank Group publishes no employees, offices or investment by state or country. The only geographic footprint measure is non-current operating assets (excluding financial assets and deferred tax assets) by location, from the FY2025 (year ended Mar 31, 2026) Financial Report 2026 on group.softbank: Japan, the U.K. and, new in this edition, the U.S. (¥3,980,282 million, up from ¥976,255 million a year earlier), plus Other. The Mar 31, 2025 comparatives match the previous edition (Japan ¥7,239,874 million, U.K. ¥4,099,932 million), and the old "Other" (¥1,143,187 million) is now split into U.S. ¥976,255 million and Other ¥166,932 million. Net sales by customer location are already in the records and not repeated. The Financial Report is SoftBank's English annual financial statements (tier filing), hosted on the company site. Quotes join the table title and row with '…'; the PDF's dot leaders are dropped; the recorded value is the Mar 31, 2026 yen column (the last column is U.S. dollars in thousands). Sites: HQ from the Annual Report 2026 corporate data, Arm's U.K. headquarters from its risk section (no city given there).
